messages:
Marisa: FYI I opened a tiny PR to update the consumption guide + dashboard panel copy for the new 'Consumption by Tier' panel. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4235 :eyes:
Leo: taking a look. main ask? copy + panel id rename?
Marisa: both. PM asked that the panel title be clearer for non-technical folks. current title is 'tiered_usage_v2' -> want something like 'Usage by Plan' (but want docs + SDK snippet to reference the stable panel slug).
Anya: re: panel slug — we should avoid exposing backend table names. propose `consumption-by-plan` as the public-facing slug. internal panels can map to it.
Devex Bot: @Marisa, checklist from docs linter: 1) confirm panel slug in dashboard.json 2) update example snippet in /snippets/usage.md 3) add one-line blurb in the migration note.
Marisa: thanks bot. I'll update dashboard.json and drop a compact curl snippet in the guide. can someone sanity-check the snippet?
Jordan: paste it here and I can quick run it locally. keep it minimal, show auth header + query param for `tier=pro`.
Marisa: snippet draft:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?panel=consumption-by-plan&tier=pro&range=30d"
```
Anya: looks good. maybe change `range=30d` to `window=30d` — we standardized on `window` in the SDK examples last quarter.
Marisa: meh, we use both in different docs. if we pick `window` then update the other snippet in 'panel-export' page.
Leo: +1 for `window`. small follow-ups: - update the dashboard panel JSON `title` (to "Usage by Plan") and `description` (one line about tokens & requests). - add a note under 'Migration notes' that old slug `tiered_usage_v2` will be aliased for 90 days.
Sam: tagging billing for a quick thumbs up on the wording? @Jordan can you ping them?
Jordan: pinged #billing — they said "fine as long as aliasing stays for 90d" :thumbsup:
Marisa: ok I'll push a new commit with: dashboard title/desc, slug `consumption-by-plan`, snippet using `window`, and a migration blurb. anyone want to review before I merge?
Anya: I can review after lunch.
Leo: I can do final pass on copy clarity. if no objections I'll merge by EOD. :rocket:
Marisa: perfect. adding one tiny extra test in CI to assert dashboard slug exists so we don't accidentally rename it later.
Devex Bot: Automated note: CI job `docs-dashboard-validation` will run on push.
Sam: thanks team! this should make the billing FAQ less confusing for new customers. :tada:
